_readme: This repository's OWN allowances for kw_common.leakguard. A key prefixed with `_` is a comment and is the only spelling this scanner ignores - anything else it does not read is refused, so a typo cannot silently drop the rules below. Format: README.md.
_why_path_exempt: This repository OWNS the guard, so its engine source is a tracked file full of synthetic deny cases. Running from this checkout, the guard recognises that file as itself and skips it. Running from an INSTALLED package it cannot - site-packages is not inside this repository - so the exemption is declared here instead, per pattern and per path, where it is visible. Every pattern is named explicitly rather than skipping the file: adding a pattern to the engine will red this repository until someone decides that pattern belongs on this list too.

allow_literals.why: functional: this repository's own clone URL. Inert against the shape denylist, live against the project-side real-literal guard that shares this engine.
functional: raw asset URLs. Same reasoning as the clone URL above.
functional: image pulls. Neutralizing it would break them; it is an account name, not infrastructure.

path_exempt.why: the guard's OWN source carries synthetic deny cases by design; a guard with no deny cases has silently stopped guarding
